hardware_used: NVIDIA GB10 (Grace-Blackwell, aarch64, 121.7 GB unified memory), 1 GPU
notes: Single ALIGNN 2.0 model (pure-PyTorch reimplementation), k-nearest-neighbor graph (8 A cutoff, 12 neighbors, full line graph). Hyperparameters from a 12-trial validation-ranked random search (test split never used for selection): lr 3.54e-3 (one-cycle), batch 128, weight decay 1e-4, hidden 384, 5 ALIGNN + 4 GCN layers, n_alignn convolution, EMA weights, best-validation-checkpoint evaluation, 300 epochs, torch_seed 312. Trained on the exact benchmark split (keep_data_order with the benchmark's train/val/test ordering). Test MAE 0.02836 eV/atom.
